meta.title: Trust in the EU
meta.question: How much do Poles trust the European Union?
meta.measure: Average trust in the European Union, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on trust or confidence in the European Union, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in the European Union?
items.notes: EVS, 1990, 1999, 2008, 2017 (4 surveys). 'A great deal / quite a lot / not very much / none at all'. In 1990 the object was the European Community (labelled European Union in the integrated file); 27% of Poles gave no answer.

items.wording: How much confidence do you have in the European Union?
items.notes: WVS Poland, 1997, 2005, 2012 (3 surveys). 'A great deal / quite a lot / not very much / none at all'. '$' keeps out 2012's 'major regional organization' (also the EU, asked twice).

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust the European Union?
items.notes: Candidate Countries Eurobarometer 2001.1, 2002.2, 2003.2, 2003.4, 2004.1 (5 surveys). 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust'. Also in the 2000 pilot (ZA3977): 6 surveys 2000-04. ZA3979, ZA3983 and ZA3986 ask it twice with the same label (in the national-institutions battery and, filtered on having heard of the EU, in the international-organisations battery); the first match is the unfiltered one. The awareness filter excluded no Polish respondents.
PGSW 2001, 2005 and 2023. 'Trust very much / rather trust / rather distrust / completely distrust'.

items.wording: Do you, generally speaking, trust the European Union? (definitely ... definitely not)
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-01, 2004-01, 2006-01, 2008-01, 2010-01, 2012-01, 2014-03, 2016-01 (8 surveys). CBOS biennial trust battery ('Czy, ogólnie rzecz biorąc, ma Pan(i) zaufanie, czy też nie ma Pan(i) zaufania, do ...'), four answers plus 'trudno powiedzieć'. Labels vary: '... - X' (2002, 2004, 2010-16), 'zaufanie do K) X' (2006-01), 'zaufanie do X' (2008-01). In 2014 the battery was split across APiW 284 (January) and 286 (March).

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust the European Union?
items.notes: Standard/EP Eurobarometer, 2004-2026, 46 surveys. 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust', DK outside the scale. '$' keeps out the Turkish Cypriot copy '(TCC)'.

items.wording: Agree or disagree: you trust the institutions of the European Union
items.notes: European Election Study 2009 (ZA5055), 1 survey. Agree-disagree with a midpoint; the object is the EU's institutions.

items.wording: You trust the institutions of the EU: yes definitely / yes to some extent / no not really / no not at all
